citations.claim: First violating step: position is non-finite (NaN) for the controller-driven body
One step before failure the body sits exactly on its waypoint with near-zero speed, the degenerate input
Body velocity has decayed to ~1.8e-13 (settled on target) just before going NaN

counterfactual.change: Moved the single waypoint 1.0 in x (18.2136 -> 17.2136) so the body never sits exactly at zero distance to target; same 1148 steps then passes with no violation.

explanation: The hover controller computes a direction to the waypoint and divides by distance. When the body settles exactly onto the waypoint (step 1147: pos == waypoint, speed ~2e-13), distance is ~0, producing 0/0 -> NaN velocity/position at step 1148. Moving the waypoint so zero-distance is never reached removes the failure.
vision_note: The red body sits almost motionless on the right side through steps 1145 to 1147. At step 1148 the body disappears entirely, leaving an empty white arena with only the green waypoint cross visible.
